name: 2-year-old
start: if curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/index.html 2>/dev/null; then echo 'static-server already running on :8000'; else nohup python3 -m http.server 8000 > /tmp/static-server.log 2>&1 & fi; for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -sf -o /dev/null http://localhost:8000/index.html && { echo 'static-server up on :8000'; break; }; sleep 0.5; done
